How It Works

Four simple steps to affordable pet care. Fast approvals, transparent pricing, and flexible payment plans designed around your budget.

01

Check eligibility in 60 seconds—no credit impact

Share basic info and instantly see your financing options. We use a soft credit check that protects your credit score—check as many times as you need.

02

Choose the plan that fits your budget

View transparent payment options side by side. See the exact monthly payment, total cost, and APR upfront—including 0% APR plans for qualified applicants.

03

Get care immediately—100% digital approval

Once approved, your vet can start treatment right away. No forms to print, no waiting for approval. Everything happens digitally in real-time.

04

Your pet heals—you pay over time

Fixed monthly payments make budgeting simple. No surprises, no hidden fees, and you can pay early anytime without penalty. Your pet gets care today.

Absolutely not. PawCare Plus uses only soft credit inquiries—the same type you use when checking your own credit report. Soft inquiries never appear on credit reports viewed by other lenders and have zero impact on your credit score. Check your options as many times as you want, risk-free.
0% APR plans are available for qualified applicants on select term lengths (usually 3-6 months). With 0% APR, you pay back exactly what you borrowed—no interest charges. Eligibility depends on your credit profile and the amount financed. If you qualify, 0% options will appear clearly in your plan choices.
PawCare Plus covers all veterinary services: emergency surgeries, routine check-ups, dental procedures, diagnostics, specialist care, cancer treatment, orthopedic surgery, prescriptions, and preventive care. If your vet provides it, we can finance it.
You'll receive an instant decision in 60 seconds or less. Once you choose your preferred payment plan, approval is immediate—no waiting, no paperwork, no phone calls. Your vet can start treatment right away.
PawCare Plus approves a wide range of credit profiles, including those with fair or limited credit history. We look at your complete financial picture—income, employment, and overall stability—not just your credit score. Many applicants with less-than-perfect credit are approved.
APRs range from ${aprMin}% to ${aprMax}%, based on your credit profile and loan term. Your rate is fixed—it never changes. Before you accept any plan, you'll see the exact APR, monthly payment, and total cost. No surprises, no variable rates.
None. Zero application fees, zero origination fees, zero hidden charges. The total amount you'll repay is shown upfront before you accept your plan. What you see is exactly what you pay.
Yes, anytime. There are zero prepayment penalties. Pay ahead or pay in full whenever you want without extra fees. Early payoff reduces your total interest since interest only accrues on your remaining balance.
We partner with thousands of veterinary clinics nationwide and are adding new partners daily. If your vet isn't enrolled yet, they can apply quickly online. You can also use our clinic finder to locate participating vets near you.
Credit cards have variable APRs (often 20-30%), revolving balances, and minimum payments that extend debt for years. PawCare Plus offers fixed-rate plans with predictable monthly payments, clear payoff dates, and 0% APR options. You know the full cost upfront—no surprises, no games.

Important Regulatory Disclosures

Loan Terms & Amounts: Loan amounts range from $${amountMin} to $${amountMax}. Minimum repayment term: 61 days. Maximum repayment term: 60 months (5 years). All loan products offered through this platform require repayment in full in 61 days or longer.

Maximum APR: The maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for payment plans available through this platform is ${aprMax}%. APR is calculated in accordance with the Truth in Lending Act (TILA), 12 CFR Part 1026, and includes the interest rate plus all applicable fees. Minimum APR: ${aprMin}%.

Representative Example: A care plan of $2,400 repaid over 12 months at a fixed APR of 0% results in 12 equal monthly payments of $200.00. Total amount repayable: $2,400.00. Total interest: $0.00. For plans outside the 0% promotional window: a plan of $2,400 repaid over 18 months at 14.99% APR results in 18 monthly payments of $148.17. Total amount repayable: $2,667.06. Your actual rate depends on credit profile, plan amount, and term selected. Not all applicants will qualify for 0% APR promotional plans.

No Guarantee of Approval: Submitting an inquiry or application does not guarantee loan approval or a specific loan offer. All applications are subject to credit review, identity verification, income verification, and lender underwriting criteria. Approval and final loan terms are at the sole discretion of the participating lender.

Credit Inquiry: Checking your rate uses a soft credit pull and will not affect your credit score. Proceeding with a full loan application may result in a hard credit inquiry, which may temporarily affect your credit score. State availability, loan terms, rates, and fees vary by lender and are subject to change without notice. Not available in all states.

Platform Disclosure: ${brand} is a veterinary payment plan platform. ${brand} facilitates payment plan options for veterinary care in partnership with licensed financial institutions. ${brand} does not guarantee approval or specific plan terms, and plan availability may vary by state. ${brand} may receive compensation in connection with plan originations, which does not influence the plan terms offered to you. Please review all plan terms, rates, and fees carefully before confirming any payment plan.

Risk Warning: Borrowing money involves financial risk. Failure to repay a loan on time may result in additional fees, negative credit reporting, and collections activity. Only borrow what you can comfortably repay. If you are experiencing financial difficulty, consider contacting a nonprofit credit counseling agency such as the NFCC (nfcc.org) for free guidance.

TCPA Notice: By submitting an inquiry, you consent to receive informational and account-related calls, emails, and SMS/text messages from ${brand} and its partners at the phone number and email address provided. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to opt out of text messages at any time. Reply HELP for help. Consent to receive marketing communications is not a condition of obtaining financing. See our for full details.
